provenance: Generated illustrative editorial artwork. Do not attribute the growers to directory members.

usage.registration: Use the desktop or mobile wide okro-harvest image on the white registration section. Both growers, baskets and crop rows remain visible.
usage.join: Optional decorative desktop header uses the compact rendition of the same okro-harvest source used in the approved Join design. Hide this decoration on small screens.
usage.how_it_works: Use the final drawing with the illustrated Farms & Suppliers header and View Profile gesture. Keep the full fingertip, button and handset visible. The mobile WebP retains the original 3:2 aspect ratio.
